passages.department:
To: danielspencer@sqmail.com
From: susanbaxter@sqmail.com
Date: August 11
Subject: Department Meeting

Dear Mr. Spencer,

I am writing to notify you about the upcoming department meeting scheduled for Monday, August 25, at 2:00 P.M. in Conference Room B of the main office.

The meeting will address finalizing budget allocations for the second half of the year and review updates to project timelines.

Please bring a copy of your latest budget report and be prepared to discuss progress on current initiatives.

If you have specific topics to include in the agenda, please email them to me by Friday, August 22. For questions or concerns, contact me at 555-1147.

Best regards,
Susan Baxter
passages.apprenticeship:
To: KevinL@timemail.com
From: ChefKen@MoltoBeneRest.com
Date: August 1
Subject: Apprenticeship Program

Hi Kevin,

Following up on your impressive interview, we are delighted to formally offer you a position in our apprenticeship program. The program will run from September 1 to November 30. As discussed, this is a paid role with an hourly wage of $20. Please confirm your acceptance by August 10.

Best regards,
Ken Cuccio
Executive Chef
Molto Bene Restaurant
passages.dance:
Subject: Rescheduling of Your Dance Class

Dear Mr. Clark,

The October 26 5:00 P.M. dance class you registered for has been rescheduled due to a sudden conflict with the instructor’s personal schedule. The session will now be held on October 28 at 6:00 P.M. If this new time does not work for you, your registration fee will be fully refunded.

Best regards,
Sophie Allen
passages.baggage:
To: Service@ForthAir.com
From: ABKant@mailape.com
Date: August 9
Subject: Baggage compensation

To whom it may concern,

I still haven’t received my checked baggage from my flight on August 7. Luckily, I had a few changes of clothes in my carry-on, but I’m running out of them. I need to know whether I can get compensation by tomorrow.

Thank you,
Abigail Kant
passages.atm:
Subject: ATM Service Request

Dear SmartATM Service Group Support Team,

This is an urgent service request for our lobby ATM (Unit #4721) at the Turner Plaza Branch. Since approximately 9:15 A.M. today, the unit has been failing all withdrawal attempts, displaying the error: “Unable to process transaction – contact support” although it is fully stocked with cash. Other functions like balance inquiries are still working normally.

This malfunction is significantly disrupting service during our peak morning hours. To manage the disruption, we are currently redirecting customers to our nearby locations.

We require the dispatch of a technician to diagnose and repair this issue. Please confirm their estimated time of arrival.

Contact me directly at 1-555-3321-7890 for coordination upon dispatch. Thank you for your prompt attention.

Best regards,
Emily Carter
Branch Operations Manager
Continental Bridge Bank
passages.sofa:
Date: July 7
Subject: Verona Sofa Delivery Date Change

Dear Mr. Pryce,

We’re writing regarding your recent order for the Verona Sofa. Unfortunately, due to unforeseen supply chain disruptions, the estimated delivery date has shifted from July 16 to July 28.

We apologize for this inconvenience. To compensate for this unexpected change, we are offering you a 5 percent refund, which will be credited back to your original payment method. This adjustment is being processed automatically today, and you should see the credit reflected in your account within 3–5 business days. This will not affect your existing warranty or support services.

If you wish to cancel your order entirely, please reply to this email by July 21.

Your satisfaction is our priority, and we’re committed to resolving this issue promptly. Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,
Sarah Lee
passages.air:
Subject: Scheduled Air Conditioning Service (September 19th)

Dear Ms. Jackson,

This is to confirm the scheduled air conditioning maintenance service for your unit on September 19th. Technicians from CoolPro Air Conditioning are expected to arrive between 9:00 A.M. and 11:00 A.M. They will call you approximately 30 minutes before arrival.

To assist the technicians, please clear at least three feet around the air conditioning units and ensure valuable items are secured in advance. For safety, they will turn off the power before starting. The service includes drainage system testing and, if necessary, air filter replacement.

If this time is inconvenient, please notify us by 5:00 P.M. on September 12th via email or phone so we can reschedule. After the service, a notice tag or service summary will be left detailing the work completed.

Regards,
Leo Koval
East Corner Apartments

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.label: A
options.text: To explain the details of a meeting

options.label: B
options.text: To announce a new office policy

options.label: C
options.text: To request feedback on a report

questions.answer: The first sentence announces the department meeting; the rest gives its agenda, time, location, and preparation. 正解：A（例題の掲載解説とも一致）。予算決定の確認や新方針の告知ではありません。
“Please bring a copy of your latest budget report” corresponds to a recent fiscal overview. 正解：C（例題の掲載解説とも一致）。進捗は話し合う準備を求められますが、持参する報告書ではありません。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.label: A
options.text: To offer a job to a candidate

options.label: D
options.text: To provide a list of required supplies

questions.answer: “We are delighted to formally offer you a position” states the central purpose. 正解：A。期間と時給はオファーの詳細です。面接はすでに行われています。

questions.prompt: When is the first day of the program?
questions.answer: The program runs from September 1 to November 30. 正解：C。August 1は送信日、August 10は承諾期限です。

questions.prompt: Why was the dance class rescheduled?

options.label: A
options.text: The dance studio needed urgent repairs.

options.label: B
options.text: The instructor had an unexpected schedule change.

options.label: C
options.text: The original class was canceled due to low enrollment.

options.label: D
options.text: The dance studio had a scheduling conflict with another event.

questions.answer: The message gives a sudden conflict with the instructor’s personal schedule as the reason. 正解：B。スタジオの修繕や別イベント、参加者数は挙げていません。

questions.prompt: When is the revised date and time for the dance class?
questions.answer: The new session is October 28 at 6:00 P.M. 正解：D。October 26 at 5:00 P.M.は元の日程です。
She writes “my flight on August 7.” 正解：A。August 9はメールの日付で、翌日は補償を知りたい期限です。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about Ms. Kant?
questions.answer: She mentions both checked baggage that has not arrived and a carry-on containing clothes. 正解：B。少なくとも預け荷物と機内持ち込みの二つを持っていました。補償はまだ問い合わせ中です。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.label: A
options.text: To demand prompt service due to a system error

options.label: B
options.text: To outline a strategy for handling customer service

options.label: C
options.text: To ask for advice on repairing a malfunctioning machine

options.label: D
options.text: To schedule a routine maintenance check

questions.answer: The urgent request asks for a technician to diagnose and repair a failing ATM and for an arrival estimate. 正解：A。顧客の誘導は既に講じた対応で、定期点検の予約ではありません。

questions.prompt: What did the Turner Plaza Branch do before sending the email?

options.label: A
options.text: It contacted the support line to log the error code.

options.label: B
options.text: It guided customers to alternative bank locations.

options.label: C
options.text: It received confirmation of the technician’s estimated arrival time.

options.label: D
options.text: It conducted a thorough review of the ATM unit.

questions.answer: “We are currently redirecting customers to our nearby locations” describes the action already under way. 正解：B。技術者の到着時刻はこれから確認を求めています。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the lobby ATM?

options.label: A
options.text: The component involved in dispensing cash has failed.

options.label: B
options.text: It is currently out of service because of a network outage.

options.label: C
options.text: It has run out of cash and cannot dispense money.

options.label: D
options.text: It will be completely replaced by a technician today.

questions.answer: Withdrawals fail although cash is stocked, while balance inquiries still work; a cash-dispensing function is therefore the likely fault. 正解：A。正確な故障部品は診断前なので推論であり、通信障害・現金切れ・本日交換の根拠はありません。

questions.prompt: What does the company offer to do?

options.label: C
options.text: Give a discount on a future purchase

questions.answer: A 5 percent refund to the original payment method is monetary compensation. 正解：D。今後の購入割引ではなく、保証は変わらないと明記されています。

questions.prompt: What was the original delivery date?
questions.answer: The estimated delivery date shifted “from July 16 to July 28.” 正解：B。July 28は変更後、July 21はキャンセル返信期限です。

questions.prompt: What should Mr. Pryce do in order to cancel his order?
questions.answer: The sender asks him to “reply to this email by July 21” if he wants to cancel. 正解：A。電話・店舗・フォームは指定されていません。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.label: A
options.text: To confirm an air conditioning service appointment

options.label: B
options.text: To explain how to replace an air filter

options.label: C
options.text: To request payment for the air conditioning service

options.label: D
options.text: To provide safety guidelines regarding air conditioners

questions.answer: The opening sentence confirms the scheduled maintenance visit on September 19. 正解：A。フィルター交換や安全措置は作業の補足で、支払い請求はありません。

questions.prompt: Which is Ms. Jackson NOT required to do?

options.label: B
options.text: Vacate the apartment during the service

options.label: C
options.text: Clear space around the air conditioner

options.label: D
options.text: Contact the office if the appointment is unsuitable

questions.answer: The message requests space around the units and secured valuables, with contact if rescheduling is needed; it never asks her to leave the apartment. 正解：B。NOT の否定を確認しましょう。

questions.prompt: What is the earliest time that the technicians may contact Ms. Jackson?
questions.answer: Arrival begins at 9:00 A.M., and they will call approximately 30 minutes before arrival, so the earliest call is about 8:30 A.M. on September 19. 正解：A。
